item.title: Internal documents show Fleet Farm ignored employee warning about gun sales to straw buyer
item.description:
Publication Date: August 19, 2026

Fleet Farm ignored warning about sales, then used those sales as examples of what should have raised red flags; company said sales made it “obvious what was going on here”

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/19_Fleet-Farm.asp

item.title: Three years after filing, bipartisan trial begins against Meta for addictive features that harm children
item.description:
Publication Date: August 19, 2026

AG Ellison and bipartisan coalition first filed lawsuit in October 2023; allege Meta knew about harms of Facebook and Instagram on young users but deceived them, their parents, and the public about the risks

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/19_Meta.asp
